```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Turn off scientific notation
options(scipen=999)

# Load tidyverse  
# install.packages('tidyverse')
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

## 

```{r}
job_records_sample <- read_csv("job-records-sample.csv")
job_descriptions_sample <- read_csv("job-descriptions-sample.csv")
```

```{r}
#filter by the word phone?
phone_descriptions <- job_descriptions_sample |> filter(str_detect(description, "phone"))

#filter job_records for health-related stuff
health_job_records <- job_records_sample |> filter(str_detect(title, "Health"))
```

```{r}
job_records_sample |> 
  mutate(year = floor_date(created, "year")) |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarise(
    count = n()
  )

```
